messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

Details weren't specified, so I've written it with bracketed placeholders you can fill in. Assumption: this is a customer-facing email or in-app notice, and the move is a migration you're running (not something customers execute themselves).

---

**Subject: [Service] is moving to [New Platform] in [Quarter]**

Hello,

In [Quarter], we're moving [Service] onto [New Platform]. We want you to hear the plan well before anything changes on your end.

**Why we're doing it.** [Current platform] has reached the limits of what it can handle at our current volume, and [specific pain: overnight batch windows keep slipping / we can't offer a European data region / support for it ends in DATE]. [New Platform] fixes that.

**What changes for you.**
- Your login URL becomes [new URL] on [date]. The old address will redirect for [90 days].
- [API v1 endpoints move to /v2. The v1 endpoints keep working until DATE.]
- [Reports run on the hour rather than nightly.]

**What doesn't change.** Your data, your account history, your pricing, and your support contacts all carry over. You don't need to re-enter anything or sign a new agreement.

**What we need from you.** Nothing before [date]. On [migration date] the service will be unavailable from [time] to [time] while we cut over. If that window is a problem for your team, reply to this message by [date] and we'll schedule you separately.

We'll send a reminder two weeks out and again the day before, plus a short guide covering the new interface.

If you have questions now, write to [email] or ask your account manager. We'd rather answer them early than have you find out on migration day.

[Name]
[Title], [Company]

---

Roughly 255 words. Tell me the real service, platform, and dates and I'll fill it in — or adjust the tone if this reads too plain for your audience.
